reviews.body: Reproduced locally: against main's translators the new cases fail (4 failed / 58 passed: cap dropped when only `max_completion_tokens` is sent, `max_tokens` wins when both are set); with this change 62/62 pass. Precedence matches the Gemini/Anthropic/Azure paths. Same bug exists on release/1.4, so labeled for backport. Thanks!
